Name: No Pause When Inactive - Global
Author: thakyZ
Description:
Disables pausing the game when the window is inactive globally, instead of per save.
However, it will still respect each save's setting for whether to pause the game when it is inactive.


If you want to edit the settings in-game I would suggest using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]spacechase0's GenericModConfigMenu[/url].

The source code for this mod can be found on my [url=https://github.com/thakyZ/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/NoPauseWhenInactiveGlobal#readme]GitHub[/url].
Please report any issue you may have on the [url=https://github.com/thakyZ/StardewValleyMods/issues]GitHub[/url] as well.
